text: Kabal was founded in 2011 by Jan Inge Pedersen and Fredrik Larsen and is backed by the investor Insight Partners, which made a growth investment in it in 2023; the Brønnøysund register lists KABAL AS as an aksjeselskap founded on 17 March 2011.
short: Kabal was founded in 2011 by Jan Inge Pedersen and Fredrik Larsen; Insight Partners made a growth investment in it.
